sentences.text: Goodrichthys is a member of the class Chondrichthyes, which includes cartilaginous fishes, and belongs to the parent group Ctenacanthiformes.
The genus was described by Moy-Thomas in 1951, yet only a single fossil occurrence of Goodrichthys has ever been recorded.
This animal lived between 346.7 and 339.9 million years ago during the Visean stage of the Carboniferous period in Scotland, specifically within the Glencartholm Volcanic Beds Formation.
